resolved.explanation: This qualification callout names ai-coding/measured-slowdown-mainly-artifact-older-models, whose verdict note says the 2026 data do not separate models from other changes. The passage compares early 2026 with early 2025 ('more sped up from AI tools now'), not newer models with older ones, yet s14 opens 'Newer tools may have changed the picture', and nothing in s14 to s16 says the change cannot be put down to the models. A reader takes the callout as partial support for the model-artifact claim, which is the claim's own wording. 'but only under conditions' also names no condition.
resolved.suggestion: Say METR compares two periods, not two generations of models, so its update cannot say how much of any change is due to newer models; drop 'but only under conditions' or name the condition.
